description: A compact Codex project monitor with light and dark themes, English and Chinese, Hook authorization guidance, and completion audio controls.
configuration.title: Codex Finish Shout Controls
command.togglePlaybackMode: Codex Finish Shout: Toggle Playback Mode
command.toggleAnnouncement: Codex Finish Shout: Toggle Spoken Announcement
command.openHookAuthorization: Codex Finish Shout: Complete Security Authorization
command.openProjectMonitor: Codex Finish Shout: Open Project Monitor
command.toggleProjectMonitorStatusBar: Codex Finish Shout: Toggle Project Monitor Status Bar
setting.language: Language for extension interfaces. Auto follows the VS Code display language (Chinese or English). Command and Settings titles follow the VS Code display language independently.
language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
setting.projectMonitor.theme: Appearance of the project monitor. Auto follows the current VS Code color theme; dark and light keep the selected appearance.
theme.auto: Follow the VS Code color theme
setting.stateDirectory: Optional state directory. Leave blank for %USERPROFILE%\.codex\codex-finish-shout-state.
setting.configPath: Optional settings file. Leave blank for %USERPROFILE%\.codex\codex-finish-shout.json.
setting.projectMonitor.showStatusBar: Show the all-project Codex running/completed summary in the status bar. Monitoring continues when hidden.
setting.playbackMode: Playback mode. An empty value keeps the backend setting.
playbackMode.loop: Loop until stopped or the safety limit is reached
playbackMode.seconds: Stop after the configured number of seconds
setting.playbackSeconds: Seconds to play when playback mode is seconds. Zero keeps the backend setting.
setting.maximumPlaybackSeconds: Safety limit for one-shot and loop playback. Zero keeps the backend setting.
setting.volume: Playback and spoken-announcement volume. Configure it here to override the backend setting.
setting.announcementEnabled: Speak the project completion announcement before the music.
setting.announcementTemplate: Spoken completion template. Use {project} for the project folder name.
setting.announcementRate: Speech rate. Zero keeps the backend setting.
command.chooseCompletionMusic: Codex Finish Shout: Choose Completion Music
setting.completionSound: Music played automatically when a task finishes. Built-in MP3 cues need no download and include editable MIDI sources. Leave empty to preserve backend or existing custom audio settings.
setting.audioFile: Absolute path to a local MP3, WAV, WMA, M4A, or AAC file. Set Completion Sound to custom to use this file.
sound.backend: Keep backend or existing audio settings; new installations use Soft chime
sound.custom: Use the local file configured in Audio File
command.repairBackend: Codex Finish Shout: Repair / Update Backend
command.checkBackend: Codex Finish Shout: Check Backend Status
setting.promotion.showToolAI: Show the dismissible ToolAI promotion in the project overview. Opens the website only when clicked.
